name: Nine-Cycle Gourd (Cửu Chuyển Hồ Lô)
lore: The founder's refining gourd of bronze and red lacquer. It holds the last turn of the Canopy Pill that Úy Đan Dương spent eighty years refining and never finished; the fumes of its eighth turn blinded him in 1141. It is in his sealed room, and his successor has a key.
build_use: The founder's piece: heavy Mercury stacks, pill-poison resistance, and one dangerous drink.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Canopy Furnace (Hoa Cái Lô)
lore: The small bronze furnace with nine stars cast on its lid that the Hall's head carries to the market at Thiên Quyền Thị, where its pills are weighed like everything else (V117). La Tử Vi took it from the founder's hands in 1141, when he could no longer see the lid.
build_use: The head's furnace: Earth debuffs that last, a ward, and steadier pills.

name: Sulphur Fan (Lưu Hoàng Phiến)
lore: A stained palm-leaf fan for stoking the furnace; the Mistress learned to fan fume at a foe before she learned to fan a fire.
build_use: Mercury stacks she fans under the lid.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Censer of the Sealed Room (Phong Thất Lô)
lore: The censer that has burned in the founder's sealed room since 1141; the fume in it is what is left of the pill that blinded him.
build_use: Mercury stacks from the fume that fills the room.

name: Cinnabar-Stained Robe (Chu Sa Bào)
lore: Red to the elbow with a century of cinnabar; nothing that lives in a pill house will touch it.
build_use: Resistance in the fume and the long sit.
